name: Hierarchical Vector Quantization
aliases: Hierarchical Vector Quantization (VQ) for Time-Varying Scalar Fields
Hierarchical Vector Quantization for Volume Rendering
definition: A compression scheme using hierarchical vector quantization to encode static and time-varying multi-dimensional data, allowing direct rendering on programmable graphics hardware.
summary: Hierarchical Vector Quantization is a lossy volumetric compression algorithm that uses multiple resolution codebooks to enable direct GPU rendering, minimizing data transfer and memory usage.
